scripts.update: npm run submodule && git fetch && git pull
scripts.generate:full: sh -c 'ts=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); tmp=${npm_config_tmp:-tmp/$ts}; final=${npm_config_save:-result/${ts}-final}; data="${npm_config_data:?use --data=<path>}"; python helpers/runner.py --mode cpg --data "$data" --save "$tmp" && python helpers/runner.py --mode kast --data "$tmp" --save "$final" && rm -rf "$tmp" && echo "Final output: $final"'
scripts.mongoose: npm run generate:cpg --data="mongoose" --output="result/mongoose/cpg" && npm run generate:kast --data="result/mongoose" --output="result/mongoose/kast"
scripts.zephyr: npm run generate:cpg --data="zephyr" --output="result/zephyr/cpg" && npm run generate:kast --data="result/zephyr" --output="result/zephyr/kast"
